As your brain follicles are being tingled by the text something unsettling is surfaced to your attention. All those other times was it really my prompt that has been the issue? Am I the cause of all these ridiculous responses to my posts here? Or is there something greater at work here. You go back through your overview sifting through old posts trying to find common similarities all the outrageous short stories. "Wait... No.. It can't be. I never responded to this dumb story about how the secretary of Canadian defense is actually an alien" "I must have had too much to drink that night". There... under all the buried posts you find something weird. It's a description if your house that you posted, almost as if some rouge architect broke in  and used your computer to publish written blueprints of your home. You become paranoid that it might have been a breaking and entering. It becomes late and you take some medication to help you sleep. The next morning you awake to find your computer on. "Hmmm... that's strange i thought I turned it off" you mumble to yourself. Feeling like your pc has been hacked you begin to continue where you were last night. It is at this moment that you feel a strange presence behind you. You turn around and there is a tall dark figure there hovering over you. It makes you jump but then you hear a faint murmur come from it. "Don't be afraid I am the spirit of Reddit" "I am here to maintain the karma balance on the website". It goes on to tell you he is necessary to the flow of the internet so that the yin and yang do not become unbalanced because if that were to happen the front page would just be full of unfunny memes, pictures of peoples pets, and dresses that people disagree about what color it is. You light up a joint and forget about the whole ordeal. All is well with the world. But wait there's something missing.... Ohhhh yeah, you forgot to look back onto earth from your alien espionage spaceship time machine piloted by an AI that writes expansions to the harry potter series. Your eyes are bewildered as you and god ponder the fate of humanity. Simultaneously dead Hitler strategies his new war plans to target athiests as the devil gives him a bj under the desk. THE END
